svg.title: Four ways to find the documents in a packet and classify each one
svg.desc: The same six-page packet, holding an invoice (pages 1 and 2), a letter (page 3) and a form (pages 4 to 6), goes through four approaches, and each returns the same three sections. 1. Page by page: each page goes to an LLM on its own and gets a class; pages in a row with the same class become one section. 2. Holistic: one LLM call reads the whole packet and returns the sections with their pages and classes. 3. Split, then an LLM classifies each section: one LLM call reads the whole packet and returns only where each document starts; then one LLM call per section classifies it. 4. Split, then a decision model classifies each section: the same first call finds the sections; then a decision model looks at each section's first page and picks its class from a fixed list.
svg.text: Four ways to find the documents in a packet and classify each one
Each tile is a page, colored by the document it belongs to:
Each box is one model call:

g.text: One call per page: what class is this page?
Pages in a row with the same class become one section.
One call reads the whole packet: which pages make up
each document, and what class is each one?
3. Split, then an LLM classifies each section
First call: where does each document start?
Then one call per section: what class is this section?
4. Split, then a decision model classifies each section
First call: where does each document start?
Then a decision model looks at each section’s first page
and picks its class from a fixed list.
